status: EXPLORATORY and POST HOC: defined by the coordinator after the main replay (results/replay.json) was seen. Jaaks was already opened. No verdict category. plan.json and plan_addendum_1.json are unchanged.
question: conf_per_cost changed the predictor and the scheduler at once. How much of its lead over verify_hits_terminal comes from the reproducibility-aware predictor and how much from the index scheduler?
data_access: one new common.exposed_ticket(..., 'allocation') then the frozen jaaks.build_panels; lines are built exactly as in replay.build_lines (same design read, costs, history probabilities, M and W)

predictor_S.meaning: static screen-only history: no pair-specific reproducibility information
predictor_S.p_s: shrunk history screen-call rate from other lines' SCREEN orientation (line.p_s; as now)
predictor_S.P_v_given_s: base = pooled panel rate over the history lines of the same panel: sum(screen call AND validation call) / sum(screen call); constant across pairs
predictor_S.values_under_I: screen value = p_s x base / c_s; verify value = base / c_v

predictor_R.meaning: reproducibility-aware static history (both orientations of other lines)
predictor_R.new_screen_order_under_V: p_sv (shrunk history P(screen call AND validation call)), ties by history_mean then rng
predictor_R.p_s: line.p_s (the reserve uses p_s under both predictors)
predictor_R.values_under_I: screen value = p_sv / c_s; verify value = p_v_given_s / c_v (= conf_per_cost)

factors.scheduler_V: verify_hits_terminal: every round first verifies every pending screen hit that fits, highest screen label first (stable), then screens in the predictor's order; in round R screening keeps ceil(sum p_s x c_v) free; terminal round R+1 verifies pending hits by label, leftover buys terminal screens in the predictor's order
factors.scheduler_I: conf_per_cost index scheduler: each round one greedy pass with fit over verify actions (value P(v|s)/c_v) and screen actions (screen value / c_s), ordered by value, then history_mean, then rng; reserve in round R on screen actions; terminal round R+1 verifies pending hits by value (ties history_mean, rng), leftover buys terminal screens by screen value

cells.S+V: must reproduce verify_hits_terminal purchase-for-purchase (252.5 measurement, 251.5 physical)
cells.R+I: must reproduce conf_per_cost purchase-for-purchase (268.0 measurement, 265.5 physical)
cells.check: per line x replicate x version, the purchase lists of S+V and R+I are compared with replay.simulate; mismatches are counted and reported, never patched

declared_non_scheduling_differences: Under S, I orders new screens by p_s (screen value p_s x base / c_s) while V orders them by history_mean, so the S-row scheduler contrast also changes the screen order.
Under I, pending hits are verified in value order (under S: constant value, so history_mean order), under V in screen-label order.
In the physical version I divides values by cost; V does not.
In the measurement version under S, a verify value (base) always exceeds every screen value (p_s x base, p_s < 1), so I never defers a verification there.
versions: measurement (B = M orientation measurements) and physical (B = W combination wells, cost 14 x design plates), budgets, rounds (R = 4 + terminal), carry-over and tie-break seeds exactly as in plan.json
endpoints_per_cell: confirmed discoveries (screen call AND paid validation call)
confirmation rate = confirmed / verified screen hits

deferred_by_priority: hit-rounds in which a pending screen hit (pending at round start) stayed unverified while an accepted screen action came before it in that round's priority order (0 by construction under V); also distinct hits ever deferred
unverified_while_screening: hit-rounds in which a pending hit stayed unverified in a round that bought at least one screen (any cause, including fit)
hits left unverified at the end (all, and excluding terminal-screen hits)

contrasts.interaction: [(R+I) - (S+I)] - [(R+V) - (S+V)], computed as contrast(R+I plus S+V, S+I plus R+V); its mean difference per line and the sum are the interaction; its relative_gain is not interpretable as a gain
contrasts.inference: verdict.contrast: paired line differences, line-stratified percentile bootstrap by tissue, 10,000 resamples, seed 20261003; line = mean of SV and VS; 125 lines

stopping_rule: one execution; tests on synthetic data first (no Jaaks outcomes); any failure of the reproduction checks is reported as found
output: results/addendum_2x2.json (new file; refusal if it exists)
code: allocation/addendum_2x2.py and allocation/test_addendum_2x2.py; replay.py is imported, not edited
